title: Beachwalk Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: If you are looking for a classic Watercolor experience, look no further than "Beachwalk". This delightfully warm and welcoming 4 bedroom home is a few yards away from Camp Watercolor and all the great amenities of the Camp District.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: * This home adheres to the Watercolor Rental Advertising Policies and Guidelines:* * Maximum Certified Number of Guests for this home is 10 * Up to 10 wristbands are included to access Watercolor’s 5 pools, including the Beach Club pool and Camp Watercolor, as well as access to the private beach. The wristbands are issued to registered guests that are staying at the home, and strictly limited by the home’s Maximum Certified Number of Guests. * This home has a private driveway and includes 2 Watercolor parking passes to use throughout Watercolor in designated locations - 2023 6-seater golf cart included (with signed waiver and refundable security deposit) - A $200/day savings! - Steps from Camp Watercolor - 3 KING suites with smart TV's in each bedroom with cable and streaming capabilities - Gas grill - Fully stocked kitchen - 2 adult sized beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). -Golf Cart- Available with a signed liability waiver and $2000 refundable security deposit HOME DETAILS: If you are looking for a classic Watercolor experience, look no further than "Beachwalk". This delightfully warm and welcoming home is a few yards away from Camp Watercolor and all the great amenities of the Camp District. Everyone will love being this close to one of five Watercolor community pools, Wood Fern Park, and newly renovated Camp Watercolor. The home is decorated in the traditional Watercolor style, with warm and comfortable decor that is very inviting. The open concept main living area features a living room with plush seating, 65" SMART curved flat screen TV, and fun accent pieces. Adjacent to the living area is a dining area with seating for 6 around the table plus nearby breakfast bar seating for 4. A full kitchen completes the main space, and includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, gas range and oven and everything you may need for creating delicious meals. When you prefer to enjoy the outdoors, there is wonderful outdoor seating on the front and back porch area, including a dining table in the screened in back porch. Grill up some steaks on the outdoor gas grill located under the overhang of the back porch. Not even rain can stop you from enjoying the beautiful Watercolor landscapes. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 10) First Floor: Bedroom 1: Master Suite- King bed, with a private entrance to the back porch, TV and en suite bath including a walk in shower and pedestal sink Bedroom 2: King bed, TV, private en-suite bath with shower/tub combo Second floor: Bedroom 3: Master Suite- KING master suite, TV, private ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 4: Bunk suite with sleeping for up to 4 in TWIN bunks with full bath (shower only) TWIN daybed on the second floor landing, not meant to be used as a sleeping space. **2023 6 seater golf cart Included (a $200/day savings!). This requires an up-front REFUNDABLE deposit of $2000 to cover any incidental damages.**If the golf cart becomes unusable during your stay there will NOT be a replacement offered. We will do our best to fix the issue in a timely fashion.** You must be 25+ yrs old to drive the golf cart. Liability waiver must be signed in advance of use. **2 Complimentary Bikes FREE WiFi Sorry no pets!

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
